entries.statement: One candidate was rejected; validation reports environment-related tokenizer download errors alongside candidate-relevant failures.
Two repair-linked candidate attempts were explicitly rejected and labeled TASK_FAILURE in one repository and one objective.
The acquisition environment returned a 403 CONNECT-tunnel failure before any response body was acquired.
Treating the two linked attempts descriptively gives 0/2 accepted and a two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson interval [0, 0.841886116991581].
